transport.sdRoot: optional existing host directory configured at process start; not mutable through protocol

state.result: cycles (decimal string), pc, a, x, y, sp, p, paused (MIA execution pause), running, stopReason, instructionBoundary

reset.behavior: assert reset for three existing computer cycles, then release; no cold recreation or cycle-counter reset; stop background execution; preserve breakpoints

step.behavior: execute up to count complete cycles; stop when MIA pauses; reject while background execution is running; ignore address breakpoints

readMemory.result: array of CPU-mapped bytes; null for unsupported side-effect-free reads; no wrapping

input.behavior: inject raw console text bytes through existing MIA input hook; no Unicode conversion or implicit stepping

setHidUsage.behavior: set or release one held usage ID 0..255 on Keyboard/Keypad page 7 or Consumer page 12; latch transition events; expose virtual device capability; no text bytes or implicit stepping

setHidBitmap.behavior: replace a 32-byte held bitmap on page 7 or 12; latch changed-bit events; expose virtual device capability; no text bytes or implicit stepping

setGamepadState.behavior: replace one 10-byte gamepad record in slot 0..3 through existing MIA transition handling; dpad bit 7 controls connection; no implicit stepping

clearGamepad.behavior: release and disconnect gamepad slot 0..3 through existing MIA transition handling; no implicit stepping

video.result: 68944 numeric bytes of coherent MIA video state; not encoded pixels

audio.result: 80 numeric bytes of MIA audio registers $12000-$1204F, with live sequencer note index and running/taken status at voice offsets 9-11; read-only snapshot

run.behavior: start unthrottled background execution; stop before an opcode at a breakpoint; does not clear MIA pause

pause.behavior: synchronously stop background execution at a complete cycle boundary

resume.behavior: clear MIA pause through host resume path, start execution, skip a just-hit breakpoint once

stepInstruction.behavior: when not running, execute at least one cycle until next opcode boundary, MIA pause, STP, or count cycle budget; ignore address breakpoints

addBreakpoint.result: unique CPU address array in insertion order

execution.runner: unthrottled; serialized ownership released every 256 cycles
execution.breakpoints: logical CPU addresses in currently mapped memory; checked only before opcode fetch, not during interrupt/reset entry
